Thirty-five minutes. Not one plane took off in South Korea.
The reason? An English listening test.
On Thursday, over half a million students sat the Suneung, the exam that can decide their university.
So a hundred and thirty flights were moved, and drones were banned across the whole country.
Offices started late, extra trains ran, and even army artillery fire was put on hold.
A whole nation, silent, so students can hear.
